releaseStatus.title: Release Status
releaseStatus.meta.description: Current release stages for TypeWhisper on macOS, Windows, and iOS.
releaseStatus.subtitle: TypeWhisper ships stable editions for macOS, Windows, iPhone, and iPad.
releaseStatus.mac.intro: macOS 1.6 is the supported stable release.
releaseStatus.mac.detail: This is the official stable path for daily use, documentation, support, and launch messaging.
releaseStatus.win.intro: Windows is a stable desktop release.
releaseStatus.win.detail: Core workflows are ready for daily use on Windows 10 and 11, with local models, file transcription, workflows, integrations, and automatic updates.
releaseStatus.ios.intro: iOS 1.0 is available on the App Store.
releaseStatus.ios.detail: This is the stable release for iPhone and iPad, including the companion Apple Watch app.
releaseStatus.mac.title: macOS 1.6
releaseStatus.mac.description: Stable 1.6 direct-download release with faster audio capture, Backup & Restore, calendar-aware meetings, live transcript updates, workflows, and expanded integrations.
releaseStatus.win.title: Windows 1.0.8
releaseStatus.win.description: Stable Windows desktop release with system-wide dictation, file transcription, app and website rules, workflows, integrations, and local automation.
releaseStatus.ios.title: iOS 1.0
releaseStatus.ios.description: Private speech-to-text with on-device engines, a voice keyboard, profiles, files, Shortcuts, dictionary, snippets, and Apple Watch support.
